Bank of Greece national totals include supplementary cruise data; regional results exclude cruise data outside the Border Survey. Travellers can visit several regions. Do not add or equate these populations.
Travel receipts are nominal euros, not inflation-adjusted value, profit or GDP. Ratios and comparisons are our calculations from matching Bank of Greece inputs.
Accommodation arrivals are check-ins, not unique visitors or airport passengers.
Central Macedonia adds short-stay establishments from 2021: recovery across this break is withheld.
Subregional comparisons are annual and hotel-only. Monthly data apply to Central Macedonia only.
HHI uses published country and residual buckets; it is not a fully country-resolved index.
2025 capacity is a later standalone signal; shared accommodation demand remains through 2024.
ELSTAT is the primary capacity source; Eurostat capacity discrepancies remain unresolved.
